run_zero_shot_retrieval_evaluation: run ZeroShotRetrievalEvaluator on COCO and Flickr30k datasets with a trained MERU or CLIP model
build_retrieval_evaluator: build a ZeroShotRetrievalEvaluator instance with custom datasets, data directory, and top-k recall values
compute_recall_at_k: compute recall@K for image-text retrieval by comparing predicted rankings against ground truth pairs
encode_dataset_features: encode all images and captions from a COCO or Flickr30k dataset using a MERU or CLIP model
review_zero_shot_evaluator: review the ZeroShotRetrievalEvaluator class to understand text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval logic
